addons.name: Vinyl
addons.description: Turns the Now Playing cover into a record sleeve. The cover slides to one side and a vinyl record peeks out from behind it. The record spins while music plays, stops when you pause, and its label shows the album art. You can pick the spin speed and the side the record sits on.
addons.author: Mirage

addons.name: Dynamic colors
addons.description: Takes a color from the album cover and tints Mirage's accent, toggles and Vitrine's glass. Cached per song, so a track change doesn't flash or stutter. A theme can keep its own accent.
addons.author: Mirage
